scenarios.name: a2a
scenarios.title: Three A2A agents
scenarios.blurb: Northwind's planning agent and Tidewater's sales agent are real A2A agents, each with its own Agent Card and JSON-RPC endpoint. scenarios.name: overreach
scenarios.title: Agent over-reaches its instruction
scenarios.blurb: The human told the agent to spend at most $175. Tidewater will not go below $190 and the agent's own budget would allow it. Trustee checks the signed intent, sees the price is outside it, and refuses to pay unattended: the purchase steps up to a human approval.

scenarios.name: pricefeed
scenarios.title: Price feed, market-checked
scenarios.blurb: Tidewater sells Northwind a competitor price feed. Before releasing the money, Northwind samples 20 rows (seeded by the signed contract), looks each up in Channel3 and compares prices. Every row is within tolerance, so Trustee captures.

market check: 20 sampled rows priced within max(5%, $1) of live Channel3 offers

scenarios.name: pricefeed-stale

scenarios.blurb: The feed matches the hash Tidewater signed, but its prices are months old and some products never existed. The Channel3 check fails on the sampled rows, the arbiter cites the market-check clause and the escrow is voided.
